prompt: Origin: authored asset, procedurally generated by this build, not by an image model (no image generation exists on this machine). Rendered in a browser canvas at 48x1024 and exported as PNG. Walnut end cheek for the desk's frame, replacing a stack of repeating-linear-gradients that read as periodic banding rather than grain. Across the width: a five-stop heartwood-to-lit-face ramp (#26160b, #56351c, #7c522f, #6b4526, #2d1b0d). Along the length: grain phase drifts via 2.9*sin(p+0.031x) + 1.7*sin(2p+1.9+0.017x) + 0.9*sin(3p+0.4+0.049x) where p = 2*PI*y/1024, so every along-length term is exactly periodic in the tile height and the asset repeats down the page with no seam. Fibre lines are three incommensurate frequencies (0.83, 1.97, 4.31) sharpened by pow(.,2.1) into dark grain lines, plus a two-term pore speckle. Applied in app/globals.css by the desk-frame utility, 24px wide, background-repeat: repeat-y. Regenerate by re-running the canvas generator described here.
